from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

img = Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('RGB')
W, H = img.size

# Let's create an annotated grid version of the dental region
# y from 0.15 to 0.75, x from 0.15 to 0.85
crop_box = (int(0.15*W), int(0.15*H), int(0.85*W), int(0.75*H))
sub = img.crop(crop_box)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sub)

# Draw grid lines every 0.05 in relative coordinates
for x_frac in [i * 0.05 for i in range(3, 17)]: # 0.15 to 0.85
    x_px = int((x_frac - 0.15) * W)
    draw.line([(x_px, 0), (x_px, sub.height)], fill='red', width=1)
    draw.text((x_px + 2, 5), f'{x_frac:.2f}', fill='red')

for y_frac in [i * 0.05 for i in range(3, 15)]: # 0.15 to 0.75
    y_px = int((y_frac - 0.15) * H)
    draw.line([(0, y_px), (sub.width, y_px)], fill='blue', width=1)
    draw.text((5, y_px + 2), f'{y_frac:.2f}', fill='blue')

sub.save('crops/grid_dentition.jpg')
print('Grid image saved')
""}
